name: FS2024 Ground
description: Walk the ground around a Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 airport (Innsbruck, LOWI) with Quake 3 player kinematics

unit_scale.explanation: FS2024 and the q3.pm.* constants are both metres, so nothing is rescaled.

axis_convention.source: WGS84 longitude/latitude, metres above sea level
axis_convention.mapping: A local tangent frame on the airport reference point: x = east metres, y = altitude - airport elevation, z = -(north metres)
axis_convention.critical: Applied once, by python/fs2024/bake_terrain.py. The engine only ever sees engine-space heights.

world_bounds_metres.note: The baked 16 km square around LOWI. fs2024.player.ground_guard keeps the player 32 m inside it.

player.explanation: The ioq3 pmove chain (q3.pm.*) unchanged, with the gta5 package's walking tune. Its traces sweep a Bullet heightfield.

asset_pipeline.reason: FS2024 streams its world elevation and land cover, so the ground is baked from a public DEM. The airport - position, elevation, runway, aprons - comes from the airport BGL the game installs, which is not encrypted. See README.md.
asset_pipeline.expected_input: D:/fs2024/lowi/terrain.fst and ground.jpg, written by python -m python.fs2024.bake_terrain

notes: Borrows gta5.sky.draw with the gta5 sky and composite shaders, and seed's postfx_fullscreen vertex shader.
